name: Nura | Animal Face
description:
Animal Face is a 50/50 hybrid with Faceoff OG x Animal Mints genetics that delivers on a minty, skunk, and earthy taste that leaves you feeling uplifted and relaxed.

Our dedication to growing the highest quality cannabis for the people is what makes Nura Cannabis so special.
